drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: One prior closure week (2026-09-28) sold 13 units (x0.45 vs baseline); noise-adjusted closure effect: x0.75. Store closed Monday, likely 1/7 of week lost. No prior closure in same season.

adjustment.analysis: The store closes Monday, which likely reduces sales. No other drivers: price unchanged, no event, no promotion. Recent weeks show no trend or seasonality. The baseline already reflects noise and recent patterns. The closure is a known demand destroyer. A single past closure week (2026-09-28, 13 units, x0.45 vs baseline) supports a downside effect. Noise-adjusted estimate for closures is x0.75. No evidence of post-closure rebound. Classical uplift model ignores this, so we adjust manually. No upside drivers. Spread widens slightly due to uncertainty in closure impact.
